articles.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
articles.description: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
articles.description: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
articles.description: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
articles.description: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer partnering with Anthropic.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec, Lucas Ropek, Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
articles.description: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
articles.description: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.
articles.author: TechCrunch Events

articles.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony AI and Nvidia
articles.description: The company plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.
articles.author: Jagmeet Singh

articles.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
articles.description: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
articles.description: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
articles.description: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta
